DEMO_CLOCK.basis: Brief §2 — one exported clock for all views and all as-of computation

DEMO_APPLICATION_DATE.basis: The hero merchant's application to the programme. Stamped before the demo clock so the RM's pending queue is populated on a cold load rather than depending on the merchant screen having been walked first; the same two-day wait the generator plants for C-APP-02.

CARDHOLDER_BASE.basis: Brief §2 — pitch-level OCBC cardholder base; the dataset is a 12,000-cardholder sample

SAMPLE_CARDHOLDERS.basis: generate.py N_CARDHOLDERS — every count in public/data/ is in sample units

ELIG_MIN_BALANCE_SGD.basis: design-decisions-log — SME gate, strictly greater than, mean closing balance over trailing 6 months

ELIG_MAX_SCORE_BAND.basis: design-decisions-log — internal OR external band ≤ 3 clears (lower = better, PD-band convention, unconfirmed)

GATE_MIN_OCBC_TXNS.basis: sme-business-customer-analysis Step 1 — below this only the demand-gap detector runs

DORMANT_TXN_PER_MONTH.basis: retailer-transaction-data-analysis Step 1 — fixed cutoff; the operative threshold is min(this, 10th percentile)

MIN_SEGMENT_SIZE.basis: Brief §2 — privacy floor for every cell shown to a merchant or RM

REACH_ROUNDING.basis: Brief §2 — reach rounded to nearest 50; with the floor this closes sequential differencing

NARROW_MAX_REFINEMENTS.basis: Merchant prompt §7.1 — narrowing cap per campaign; applied narrowings and floor refusals both count, a refusal is still a query

NARROW_PROTECTED_TERMS.basis: Merchant prompt §7.1 — narrowing that amounts to a differential offer by protected characteristic is refused and explained; age band and location stay permitted as ordinary commercial targeting

LIFT_PRICE_BAND_TOLERANCE.basis: Brief §5 — |cardholder pref − merchant band| ≤ 1; excludes Charles, keeps Bernice

GAP_SLOT_RATIO.basis: Brief §5 — slot ≤ 75% of own daypart-matched mean slot volume

GAP_HIGH_CONF_WEEKS.basis: Brief §5 — high confidence needs own-baseline ≥ 10/12 weeks and the peer test

GAP_COLD_START_WEEKS.basis: Brief §5 — under 4 weeks of history → cold-start branch

GAP_MIN_SLOT_BASELINE.basis: A week counts toward the own-baseline test only when the daypart's mean slot volume that week is >= 5 transactions; below that a slot is too thin to call

GAP_MIN_VOLUME_12W.basis: Gap detection needs >= 500 transactions in the trailing 12 weeks; below that the merchant is told the data is too thin rather than shown noise

GAP_PEER_RATIO.basis: Peer test margin: own slot share must sit below 80% of the peer-median share, so ordinary weekend/weekday variation is not read as a gap

FREQ_CAP_OFFERS.basis: portfolio-allocator Step 3 — concurrent offers per cardholder per 30 days, placeholder

PORTFOLIO_WEEKLY_CEIL_SHARE.basis: RM prompt §3.2 — 50,000 cardholders contactable per week is 6.25% of the 800,000 base. Held as a share of the consented base, not a headcount, so the ceiling lands in whatever units the panel is counting; the share is still a placeholder until it has a basis

PROFILE_WEIGHT_STEP.basis: Customer view §5 / brief §4 — how much one redemption moves a cardholder's category weight toward the redeemed merchant's category before renormalising; a placeholder learning rate until relevance is calibrated

ASSUMED_GROSS_MARGIN.basis: Brief §5 — café gross margin assumed for net contribution; not merchant-reported

RETURN_WINDOW_DAYS.basis: Brief §5 — unprompted return measured within 30 days of last redemption

TRAILING_MONTHS.basis: Merchant prompt §6 trading summary — trailing 6 months

INCREMENTAL_SHARE.basis: Expected share of redemptions that would not have happened anyway, by target pool. Ordered by the reward skill's caution column; the acquisition figure is the winner campaign's (16% − 4%) / 16% = 0.75; the rest are assumptions

scale_disclosure: Counts are in sample units: 12,000 synthetic cardholders standing in for OCBC's 800,000. Caps are held as a share of the consented base and computed into sample units, so no panel mixes the two scales.

absolute_by_design.MIN_SEGMENT_SIZE: A privacy floor in cardholders. As a share it would shrink with the sample and stop closing the differencing attack.
absolute_by_design.REACH_ROUNDING: Rounding granularity in cardholders, paired with the floor for the same reason.
absolute_by_design.GATE_MIN_OCBC_TXNS: Evidence threshold on the merchant's own transactions, not a cap on the cardholder base.
absolute_by_design.LIFT_MIN_SUPPORT: Evidence threshold on how many cardholders a merchant pair shares, not a cap on reach.
absolute_by_design.LIFT_MIN_DAYPART_AVAILABILITY: Already a fraction, of one cardholder's own week rather than of the base.
absolute_by_design.LIFT_PRICE_BAND_TOLERANCE: A distance in price bands, on a scale that does not grow with the base.
absolute_by_design.GAP_MIN_WEEKS: A count of weeks in the trailing window, unrelated to the size of the base.
absolute_by_design.GAP_MIN_SLOT_BASELINE: Evidence threshold on a daypart's mean slot volume.
absolute_by_design.GAP_MIN_VOLUME_12W: Evidence threshold on the merchant's own trailing volume.
absolute_by_design.ELIG_MIN_BALANCE_SGD: A currency threshold on one merchant's balance.
absolute_by_design.ELIG_MAX_SCORE_BAND: A credit-band position on a 1–5 scale.
